content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a secretary-general position at the Council of the Baltic Sea States. Tell about your experience in Baltic Sea region cooperation, environmental policy, and security issues. Also describe how you have promoted regional stability and sustainable development in the Baltic Sea area. Length about 400 words.

materials.scenario: Hakemus Itämeren valtioiden neuvoston pääsihteerin tehtävään
